notes: Tuition: the fee of 178 euros per year is the general rate shown on the Parcoursup page; the Campus France page (https://www.maroc.campusfrance.org/le-cout-des-etudes-les-bourses) states a differentiated rate for non-EU students, but that general page is about French public higher education as a whole, not clearly this programme, so it was left out of the tuition fact. The programme is taught in French; the possibility of elective modules in English was not used to add 'en'.
